job: Read the history of one thing as a list of events in time order.
purpose: A vertical rail with 8px dots for ordinary events and 20px icon nodes for the ones that matter. Each item has a title, a time and optional detail or a card. The live item pulses until it finishes. A group item folds similar events into one "×12" row.
useWhen: A run, a key or a deployment needs its history shown newest first or oldest first.
Events have a tone: failed, rate limited, started by someone.
Many similar events should fold into one group row.

avoidWhen.when: Parallel staged work with a graph of what ran after what.
Steps of an agent run with tool calls.
A log with levels, search and follow.

states.name: live
states.how: data-live on an item; its dot pulses until it is removed

states.name: group
states.how: data-kind="group" on an item; a fd-timeline-more button expands it

variants.useWhen: A row that stands for many similar events.
Event: something finished or is healthy.
Event: something needs attention soon but is not broken.
Event: something failed or is destructive.
Event: one thing to notice, in the brand colour.
Event: output from an agent or another special category.

parts.role: The dot or icon on the rail.
A framed detail such as an error trace.
The button of a group item.
